name: headless-pm
description: 101 PM skills, 8 domain subagents, and cross-linked PM workflows for product managers. Discovery, strategy, execution, GTM, analytics, stakeholder comms — grounded in PM methodology.

plugins.name: pm-discovery
plugins.description: Discovery domain: 12 skills for problem framing, hypothesis generation, opportunity mapping, and PRD writing.

plugins.name: pm-customer-research
plugins.description: Customer research domain: 13 skills for interviews (Mom Test, JTBD, switch), segmentation, and survey design.

plugins.name: pm-strategy
plugins.description: Strategy domain: 13 skills for vision, strategy stack, OKRs, roadmaps, prioritization, and portfolio.

plugins.name: pm-market-research
plugins.description: Market research domain: skills for market sizing, competitive analysis, ICP definition, and positioning.

plugins.name: pm-execution
plugins.description: Execution domain: sprint planning, backlog, estimation, standup, retro, and delivery skills.

plugins.name: pm-gtm
plugins.description: GTM domain: go-to-market strategy, launch planning, feature flags, pricing changes, and release lifecycle.

plugins.name: pm-analytics
plugins.description: Analytics domain: metrics frameworks, North Star selection, funnel analysis, A/B testing, and adoption.

plugins.name: pm-stakeholder
plugins.description: Stakeholder domain: exec briefs, status updates, risk escalation, audience tailoring, and influence skills.

plugins.name: pm-orchestrator
plugins.description: PM subagent hub: describe your task and get routed to the right domain automatically.
